post.description: Issues an invoice (factura, XML 2.1.0). Flashpi computes the line subtotals, the taxes per rate, the tip and the total with the SRI rounding rules; send expectedTotal to have a different total refused. Issuing is asynchronous: the document is validated, numbered (sequential and access key) and stored with status `processing`, and the response is 202 Accepted. post.description:
Emails the authorized document (RIDE PDF and XML) to the email address of its request, also when the email was not requested when it was issued. A new delivery appears in `email.deliveries` and `email.status` becomes `queued`; the email goes out once the RIDE exists (a failed RIDE is generated again first). Follow it with GET /v1/documents/{id} or the `document.email.*` events. Requires a read_write API key; an issuer-scoped key only reaches its issuer.

Daily limits (calendar days in Ecuador, UTC-5): a document can be emailed again at most 3 times a day in test mode, and an account queues at most 20 test emails a day (automatic emails of authorized documents and resends together). Live limits default to 10 resends per document and 200 emails per account a day, and Flashpi queues a limited number of emails a day across all accounts. Beyond them the answer is 429 with `Retry-After` and `resetsAt` (the next midnight in Ecuador), plus the `limit` of an account or document limit; an automatic email beyond a limit becomes a failed delivery with the error `account_email_limit_reached` or `platform_email_limit_reached`.

Test mode: documents are only emailed to verified email addresses of the account's team members (console users who verified their address). Any other recipient is never emailed: the automatic email becomes a failed delivery with the error `test_recipient_not_allowed`, and this endpoint answers 409. Live documents are not restricted this way.

info.title: Flashpi Invoicing API
info.description: Issue and query electronic tax documents authorized by Ecuador's SRI. Authenticate with an API key as a Bearer token: fp_test_ keys use the SRI test environment and fp_live_ keys use SRI production. Errors follow RFC 9457 (application/problem+json), in Spanish with Accept-Language: es. Any operation can also answer 500 internal_error (unexpected: retry with backoff, reusing the Idempotency-Key on a POST, and give requestId to support); 502, 503 and 504 answers from the edge may carry no Problem Details body. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header (a UUIDv7, also returned as requestId in errors). Send an optional X-Correlation-Id header (1 to 128 letters, digits and -_.:/+=) to tie a request to your own records: it is echoed back, and an invalid value is rejected with 400 invalid_correlation_id. JSON bodies are limited to 1 MB; a larger body gets 413 payload_too_large.

email.description: Where the authorized document is emailed (see `options.sendEmail`).

rate.description: For `vat`, the rate: `0`, `5`, `8` (differentiated, tourism), `12`, `13`, `14`, `15`, `exempt` or `not_subject`; it must be in force on the issue date (for credit and debit notes, on the modified document issue date). code.description: For `ice` only (required): the 4-digit ICE code of TABLA 18.

DocumentTax.description: A tax of a line. Every line needs exactly one `vat`; invoices and credit notes accept one ad valorem `ice` too. Flashpi computes the bases and amounts.

auxiliaryCode.description: A second code, for example the barcode.

additionalDetails.description: Up to 3 extra details printed with the line (name → value, 1 to 300 characters).

method.description: Payment method: `cash` (without the financial system), `debt_offset`, `debit_card`, `electronic_money`, `prepaid_card`, `credit_card`, `other_financial_system` (bank transfers, checks and other payments through the financial system) or `securities_endorsement`.

term.description: Payment term in `termUnit` units. Required on purchase settlements.

issuerId.description: The issuer (taxpayer) that issues the document.

establishment.description: Establishment code (3 digits) registered on the issuer.

emissionPoint.description: Emission point code (3 digits) registered on the establishment.

issueDate.description: Issue date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Ecuador; it cannot be later.
